army-leyte-ch5.claim: The 20 Oct landings: X Corps north (Palo to Tacloban), XXIV Corps south (Dulag); A-day partly cloudy to cloudy

navy-bases-ch29.claim: Seabee detachment handled pontoon barges and causeways at the landing and reassembled cells as pontoon piers

reference.source: No runway: a beach. One representative beachhead stands for the landing sectors, on the shipped terrain's straight east-facing coast between Palo and Tacloban (X Corps sector, 11.179 N 125.017 E, the shore at local x about -10 to -50). The frame is center (-30900,-42200), heading 23 so local +x points seaward (east-southeast) and local z runs along the shore; fitted by tools/sites/localMap.ts 2026-10-17. The Dulag sectors are not drawn. Every pose, count and kind is invented gameplay layout unless its basis says otherwise.
